name: Death Diabolos
description: A fearsome balance-type devil that devours both attack and defense. Death Diabolos shifts states mid-battle — adapting its curved horns to crush any opponent who dares challenge it.

ability.name: Devil's Convergence
ability.description: Death Diabolos reads the enemy's type. vs Attack: grants a 70 HP shield and +20 DEF for 2 turns. vs Defense: gains +30 ATK for 2 turns and next attack ignores defense. vs Stamina/Balance: drains 35 HP (true damage) and heals the same amount. All cases also deal +20 bonus explosive damage.

special_move.name: Diabolic End
special_move.description: Death Diabolos launches four rapid horn strikes — each hit has a chance to land a critical blow, tearing through the opponent with devil precision!
